title: Red-cell size dispersion × hemoglobin concentration adds no clear transferred information about elevated CRP
abstract: In NHANES 2003–2004 to 2007–2008 temporal-sample transfer, adding a centered RDW × MCHC interaction to flexible CBC main effects changed weighted Brier loss by an improvement of 0.00001320 (95% joint PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00107146 to 0.00147047), providing no clear evidence of incremental prediction of CRP >3 mg/L. Negative result for one prespecified joint erythrocyte representation; temporal transfer in separate probability samples, with previously used target data.
